summary: BV Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 5, 2026, disclosing the Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond non-objection to a stock repurchase program of up to 10% of outstanding common stock (~861,000 shares). Repurchases will commence after the current program finishes (~45,000 shares remaining). Purchases may be made via open market, private transactions, block trades, or a Rule 10b5-1 plan. No specific price, premium, or timeline was given. The board has not retained an outside advisor. The filing is a routine capital return announcement, not a special situation. Watch: execution pace and any future accretive actions.
